arabic_html:
ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا۟
لَكُمْ فَٱخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَٰنًۭا وَقَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ ۞
translation: Those to whom people said, 'Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them.' But it merely increased them in faith, and they said, 'Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.'
explanation_html: Told the enemy had massed against them, their fear turned to faith. Ibn Kathīr: they answered — 'Allah is sufficient for us, the best Disposer of affairs' — and it only increased them in faith.
explanation_vo: Told the enemy had massed against them, their fear turned to faith. Ibn Kathir: they answered — 'Allah is sufficient for us, the best Disposer of affairs' — and it only increased them in faith.
